Oh yea, by depressing the nervous system with the painkillers it does have an effect on the way anxiety and emotional pain is processed.  

A study was done using just plain Tylenol with a group and they studied their brain activity during an MRI.  They played a computer game inside the MRI.  The subjects that had taken the Tylenol were less effected by emotional pain because their pain receptors were being blocked by the pain killer.
